name: VHF airband data links and distress
notes: airband_vhf plus the 121.5 MHz distress (guard) channel in AM, in one capture of one radio: ACARS on every VHF channel, VDL Mode 2, and the guard channel to listen to (play its audio, or `job_attach` a transcriber); it is voice, not a data link, so nothing from it reaches the map. The capture is 121.5-137.0 MHz, twice airband_vhf's: start airband_vhf instead when the radio's CPU budget is tight or the guard channel is not wanted.

wide.note: a radio that captures 121.5-137.0 MHz at once (16 MHz)
